$meta.note: Values are taken from the design canvas artboards. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2 ratios against the theme background unless stated. Light values are confirmed on the home page only.

accent.use: newly lit, changed-in version, focus ring

edgeCross.use: focused star's edge that leaves the system; same colour as edgeActive, the dash is the signal

treeGuide.use: Learn tree branches under the hubs. Decorative: carries no information the list does not

namespacePlot.use: rounded outline around one namespace's objects, mono 10px label

mediaBody.use: video (triangle) and post (bar) bodies next to the hub they mention

mediaBodyNew.use: a body that landed in the last 7 days

communityRing.use: ring around a star that has community evidence; reuses tier.community text colour

versionFrame.use: 1px frame, offset 4px, around an object changed in the lens version

obsolete.use: obsolete object under the version lens

galaxy.lensDim: opacity 0.3 for everything the active lens does not match

port.use: label on the canvas edge where a cross-system edge exits

ringGuide.use: ring circles and the direction divider. Decorative

edge.use: resting edge. Brighter than galaxy.edge (1.9) on purpose: here the edges are the content, so they must pass 3:1

plane.use: one parallelogram per plane. Decorative: the plane label carries the meaning

planeActive.use: the plane a lens is acting on (country = BE)

line.use: resting line between planes. Same value as neighbourhood.edge: a line here is a fact

coreSample.use: vertical line through the focused star on every plane

relationInPlane.use: object relations of the focused star, inside the code plane only

noLineUpLens.use: the same, under the coverage lens

layers.countryMark: system colour of Localizations (hue 181); accent when it is in the core sample

accent.use: newly lit ring and text. Borderline AA: use at 14px+ or darken before using for small text

galaxy.glow: none: brightness is size and opacity only

edge.note: fills the TODO in the base file as a proposal. Decorative weight only

mediaBodyNew.note: borderline, same caveat as light accent: shape and the 'landed' label carry it

eventNode.note: borderline: the diamond shape carries it

coreSample.note: borderline: the 2px width and the vertical direction carry it

system.$rule: One hue per galaxy system, evenly spaced. hue = round((index * 360 / 21 + 250) % 360). Dark: oklch(0.80 0.12 hue). Light: oklch(0.45 0.15 hue). Hue alone does not separate 21 systems: always pair with the label.

official.label: official - Microsoft
official.light: TODO: not designed yet. Suggested: border and text #2447B8

review.reviewed: TODO: not designed yet. Intended: same shape, solid border

color.roadmapStatus: TODO: roadmap feature page not designed yet

type.source: Google Fonts. Bricolage Grotesque opsz 12..96, weights 400/600/700. JetBrains Mono 400/500. Self-host for GitHub Pages.

cameraFly.use: galaxy zoom and pan between levels, and counter-scaling of labels

dim.use: opacity of unfocused systems, edges, labels

edgeDraw.use: focused star's edges draw outward from the star, in-system first, cross-system after

portFly.use: same as cameraFly: clicking a port flies along the edge into the target system

neighbourhoodRingFill.use: loading: rings draw at once, nodes fade in ring by ring

neighbourhoodRecentre.use: selected neighbour slides to the centre, old centre slides to its ring position. Same curve as panelSlide

layersTilt.use: flat to layered and back; lines fade in over the last 200ms

layersCoreSample.use: the vertical line draws from the focused star outward, up and down

motion.reducedMotion: camera fly, tilt and re-centre become cuts; edges and the core sample appear without drawing; the pulse becomes a static double ring (r and r * 1.5, opacity 1 and 0.35); nodes appear without fading (D66: tokens.D, C and A)

galaxy.starGlow: box-shadow 0 0 (diameter * 1.6) system colour; active star: diameter * 3, white
galaxy.minHitArea: 6 world px (about 26 screen px at system zoom): below the 44px target, see HANDOFF
galaxy.systemLayout: two-arm spiral kept, but index order comes from the pipeline: greedy ordering that puts the pair with the highest cross-system edge weight next to each other along an arm. The formula in the base file is unchanged
galaxy.systemEdge: width = 1 + 3 * weight / maxWeight screen px, only for the top 2 edges per system at galaxy level
galaxy.hubPosition: radial tree of the Learn table of contents: depth = distance from the system centre (4 levels), sibling order = TOC order, on the left 200 degrees of the system
galaxy.objectPosition: squarified treemap of the namespace tree inside the right 160 degrees; each namespace is a plot, objects sit inside their plot, most connected nearest the system centre
galaxy.mediaPosition: at 14 world px from the hub they mention most, fanned in 30 degree steps, max 6 per hub then a count
galaxy.starOpacity: 0.35 + 0.65 * evidence / maxEvidence, where evidence = Learn pages + videos + posts naming the star (replaces weight in the base formula)
galaxy.crossEdgeLimit: max 6 ports per focused star, grouped by target system, the rest as '+ n systems' in the panel

ring.r2: 260px: grouped kinds (pages and codeunits, extensions, subscribers) as pills
ring.arc: top 60 degrees at r2: Learn pages, videos, posts

neighbourhood.direction: right half = the centre points to it (relates to); left half = it points to the centre (referenced by). Never mixed
neighbourhood.overflow: one '+ n more' pill per ring side; opens the full list in the panel, grouped by system
neighbourhood.nodeColour: system colour of the neighbour (color.system), always with its label

edgeStyle.extends: double line (3px stroke with 1px background stroke inside)

neighbourhood.expand: one neighbour at a time; its own top 2 neighbours plus a count fan out 90px beyond the ring; expanding another collapses the first

perPageDiagram.content: centre + top neighbour per ring (max 5) + total link count
perPageDiagram.render: inline SVG written at build time, no script

layers.tilt: one fixed affine transform, no free orbit: x' = x - 0.92 * v * planeDepth, y' = planeTop + v * planeDepth, with v the normalised y of the flat system. As drawn: plane 760 wide, 130 deep, sheared 120 left, planes 180 apart
layers.sharedXY: every plane uses the flat system's x/y from the D layout. An object's Learn hub sits where the D layout put it, so lines are slanted, not vertical; only the core sample of the focused star is drawn as one vertical line, by snapping its sample to the star's x
layers.levelOfDetail: code plane draws the D stars at full size plus every other object of the system as a 7px hollow or filled square; lines between planes are drawn for the D stars and the focused star only, the rest on demand through a lens
layers.maxLines: about 150 lines on screen at rest; a lens may raise it for the plane it acts on
layers.foldAway: a lens that uses two planes folds the other two to 24px strips with their label
